app.title: Audio Latency Tester
app.description: Test the latency of your audio output devices

instructions.title: How to use
instructions.selectDevices: Select your microphone and audio output device (headphones or speakers).
instructions.placeDevice: Place the output device close enough for the microphone to pick up the sound clearly.
instructions.preview: Click {action} to monitor the live microphone level.
instructions.adjustThreshold: Adjust the detection threshold: drag the red thumb so the level bar stays below it during silence, but crosses it when a click sound is played.
instructions.start: Click {action}. The tool plays random click sounds through the output device and records when the microphone detects each one.
instructions.calculation: Latency is calculated as the time difference between playback and detection, in milliseconds.
instructions.stop: Click {action} when you are done. Review individual measurements and the average latency in the results section.

support.outputDeviceUnsupported: Your browser does not support output device selection. Audio will play through the system default output. Use Chrome or Edge for the most accurate results.

permission.title: Microphone access required
permission.description: This tool reads audio from your microphone to measure playback latency. Allow access to list your devices and start testing.
permission.denied: Permission was denied. Check your browser's site settings and try again.

threshold.label: Detection Threshold
threshold.description: The blue/green bar shows microphone level; the red thumb shows the detection threshold. Set the threshold between silence and the click sound.

errors.listDevicesUnsupported: Your browser does not support listing audio devices.
errors.microphonePermissionDenied: Microphone permission denied. Please allow access in your browser settings.
errors.listDevicesFailed: An error occurred while listing audio devices.
errors.previewFailed: An error occurred while starting microphone preview.
errors.recordingUnsupported: Your browser does not support audio recording.
errors.recordingFailed: An error occurred while recording audio.
errors.selectedMicrophoneMissing: Selected microphone not found. Refresh devices and try again.
errors.recordingStartFailed: An error occurred while starting the recording.
errors.playbackFailed: An error occurred while playing the recording.
errors.selectedOutputUnavailable: Selected output device is unavailable. Playing through the default output.
errors.measurementStartFailed: An error occurred while starting the measurement.
